ui.gambling.title: Gaming table
ui.gambling.lead: A game of dice, a purse of gold. Choose your game and the person across the table.
ui.gambling.none: No one is ready to play at this table.
ui.gambling.no_table: Stand within reach of a gaming table to invite someone.
ui.gambling.invited: Invitation sent. The other player answers Y or N on their card.
ui.gambling.hide_hint: Esc hides this window. The game and its timer keep going. Open it again from G, Gaming table.
ui.gambling.rules.Poker: Both roll five d6. Each player may raise once per round, by 1 to the original stake, limited by what both carry. The other calls or folds, losing the match. Both then choose any dice to reroll, once. First to win {rounds} rounds wins the match.
ui.gambling.rules.Favor: Both roll two d6. The higher total wins the pot. No raise or reroll. Equal totals are rolled again.
ui.gambling.rules.tiebreak: Equal ranks: compare the larger group first, then its value, then the rest from highest. For two pairs compare the higher pair first, then the lower, then the fifth die. Identical hands and equal straights tie.
ui.gambling.rules.common: A whole stake of {min} to {max} gold is taken from both when the invitation is accepted. Winner takes the pot less {cut}% (rounded down). A draw refunds stakes and raises. After {replays} replays of the same tied round, another tie draws the match.
ui.gambling.rules.time: Invitations wait {invite} seconds; each decision waits {decision} seconds. Timeout: no raise, fold on a call, keep unconfirmed dice. Leaving reach, the world or the server loses the match. Both gone or staff cancellation refunds both. Gold owed while away arrives next visit. Muted or frozen players cannot start or accept.
ui.gambling.Raise.you: Your decision: raise or continue to the reroll.
ui.gambling.Raise.other: Your opponent is deciding whether to raise.
ui.gambling.Call.you: Your opponent raised. Call {amount} gold or fold the match.
ui.gambling.Call.other: Your opponent must call {amount} gold or fold.
ui.gambling.Reroll: Choose dice to reroll. Click or press 1 to 5, then confirm with Space or Enter. Choose none to keep all.
ui.gambling.confirmed: Your dice are confirmed. Waiting for your opponent.
ui.gambling.RoundResult: Round complete. The next roll follows shortly.
ui.gambling.Rolling: The server is rolling the dice.
ui.gambling.raise_limit: Up to {amount} gold, limited by both purses.
